description: Statistical control on the -1 subsite steric test: can it separate the dual-specificity GH10 Cex from strict xylanases, and where does Tlr1902 fall
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# values computed in the previous cell (transferred-glucosyl clearance, A)
rec = [
 ("S. lividans Xyn10A  1E0V","glucosyl-bound reference",3.70,4.61,3.43,2.46,0.00,0.00),
 ("S. lividans Xyn10A  1OD8","strict xylanase",2.50,1.90,1.75,0.83,0.26,0.14),
 ("S. lividans Xyn10A  1V0L","strict xylanase",2.43,1.73,1.71,0.85,0.23,0.15),
 ("P. simplicissimum XynA 1B3Z","strict xylanase",2.71,2.07,1.28,0.53,1.11,0.09),
 ("X. axonopodis XynB  4PMY","strict xylanase",2.60,2.55,1.21,0.97,1.62,0.78),
 ("T. aurantiacus XynI 1GOQ","strict xylanase",2.64,2.01,1.33,0.62,1.08,0.12),
 ("C. thermocellum Xyn10B 2WYS","strict xylanase",2.64,2.22,1.75,1.63,1.20,0.19),
 ("C. fimi Cex 1FH7","xylanase + aryl-cellobiosidase",2.53,1.91,1.28,0.51,0.91,0.13),
 ("C. fimi Cex 2EXO","xylanase + aryl-cellobiosidase",2.57,1.89,1.75,0.60,0.90,0.19),
 ("Q8DHP3 Tlr1902 (AlphaFold)","query",2.69,2.83,2.64,1.27,1.57,1.19)]
df=pd.DataFrame(rec,columns=["enzyme","class","m1_C6","m1_O6","m2_C6","m2_O6","rmsd","nuc_disp"])

strict=df[df["class"]=="strict xylanase"]
cex   =df[df["class"].str.contains("cellobiosidase")]
q     =df[df["class"]=="query"].iloc[0]

print("CONTROL: does -1 C6 clearance separate a known dual-specificity GH10 from strict xylanases?")
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(cex["m1_C6"],strict["m1_C6"],alternative="two-sided")
d=(cex["m1_C6"].mean()-strict["m1_C6"].mean())/strict["m1_C6"].std(ddof=1)
print("  strict xylanases (n=%d): %.2f +/- %.2f A   [range %.2f-%.2f]"%(len(strict),strict['m1_C6'].mean(),strict['m1_C6'].std(ddof=1),strict['m1_C6'].min(),strict['m1_C6'].max()))
print("  C. fimi Cex      (n=%d): %.2f +/- %.2f A"%(len(cex),cex['m1_C6'].mean(),cex['m1_C6'].std(ddof=1)))
print("  Mann-Whitney U=%.1f p=%.3f, Cohen d=%.2f -> assay does NOT separate the dual-specificity enzyme"%(u,p,d))

print("\nQUERY: where does Tlr1902 fall?")
z=(q["m1_C6"]-strict["m1_C6"].mean())/strict["m1_C6"].std(ddof=1)
print("  Tlr1902 -1 C6 clearance %.2f A, z = %+.2f vs strict xylanases (p=%.2f, two-sided)"%(q["m1_C6"],z,2*(1-stats.norm.cdf(abs(z)))))
print("  superposition uncertainty for Tlr1902: CA RMSD %.2f A, nucleophile displacement %.2f A"%(q["rmsd"],q["nuc_disp"]))
print("  between-enzyme spread in -1 C6 among strict xylanases: %.2f A"%(strict['m1_C6'].max()-strict['m1_C6'].min()))
print("  -> transfer error (%.2f A) exceeds the signal being measured (%.2f A)"%(q["rmsd"],strict['m1_C6'].max()-strict['m1_C6'].min()))

print("\nWHY THE ASSAY FAILS: 1E0V is the same protein as 1OD8/1V0L but caught with a glucosyl at -1.")
print("  -1 C6 clearance, S. lividans Xyn10A: %.2f A when glucosyl-bound (1E0V) vs %.2f / %.2f A when xylose-configured (1OD8 / 1V0L)"
      %(df.iloc[0]["m1_C6"],df.iloc[1]["m1_C6"],df.iloc[2]["m1_C6"]))
print("  the contacting Trp moves on binding, so the apparent clash is induced-fit, not exclusion.")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
col={"glucosyl-bound reference":"#2b8a3e","strict xylanase":"#1864ab","xylanase + aryl-cellobiosidase":"#e8590c","query":"#c92a2a"}
for a,(k,ttl) in zip(ax,[("m1_C6","-1 subsite: clearance around glucosyl C6"),("m2_C6","-2 subsite: clearance around glucosyl C6")]):
    y=np.arange(len(df))
    a.barh(y,df[k],color=[col[c] for c in df["class"]])
    a.set_yticks(y); a.set_yticklabels(df["enzyme"],fontsize=8); a.invert_yaxis()
    a.axvline(3.4,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); a.text(3.45,len(df)-0.4,"C...C van der Waals\ncontact (3.4 A)",fontsize=7,va="top")
    a.set_xlabel("minimum distance to protein heavy atom (A)"); a.set_title(ttl,fontsize=10)
    a.set_xlim(0,5)
h=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=v) for v in col.values()]
ax[1].legend(h,col.keys(),fontsize=7,loc="lower right")
fig.suptitle("Steric test of the Tlr1902 (Q8DHP3) cleft: glucosyl units transferred from the 1E0V cellobiosyl-enzyme intermediate",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
